تعلوطين (form XIII)
# تَعْلَوِّطِينَ (taʕlawwiṭīna) /taʕ.law.wi.tˤiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
# تُعْلَوَّطِينَ (tuʕlawwaṭīna) /tuʕ.law.wa.tˤiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
